institution.name: Charles A Jones Career and Education Center

about.summary: The Charles A Jones Career and Education Center (CAJ) is a vocational education institution located in Sacramento, California, established in 1967. It provides career training programs focusing on areas with high employment opportunities and operates under the Sacramento City Unified School District and the California Department of Education. CAJ's curriculum employs varied instructional methods, including hands-on shop projects and externships.

documents.title: Glossary of Terms - SCUSD Action Plan
documents.summary: The Sacramento Unified School District's Action Plan features a comprehensive glossary of terms relevant to educational practices focused on equity, community engagement, and teaching methodologies. Key concepts include assessment, equity, cultural competency, and community schools—each aimed at enhancing understanding and implementation of inclusive and effective educational strategies.

documents.title: Strategy and Continuous Improvement
documents.summary: The Sacramento City Unified School District's Strategy and Continuous Improvement team aims to strategically leverage data to enhance student outcomes by expanding post-secondary choices. Their goals include managing performance initiatives, designing integrated management systems, and aligning district resources with strategic priorities. Additionally, they ensure accountability through comprehensive assessment and planning across district, state, and federal levels.
